fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia's PIF completely divested Electronic Arts in Q3 – liquidated all holdings previously acquired together with Silver Lake and Affinity Partners.
fields.summary_ko.1: PIF continues to hold stakes in Lucid Group LCID (177.09 million shares), SpaceX SPCX (154.15 million shares), and Uber Technologies UBER (72.84 million shares).
